query:
select
                    id as "id: Uuid",
                    name,
                    is_privileged,
                    created_at as "created_at: _",
                    updated_at as "updated_at: _"
                from
                    groups
                where
                    $1 is null or id in (
                        select
                            group_id
                        from
                            users_groups
                        where
                            user_id = $1
                    )
